description: Mobile emulation 390x844 CSS px, DPR 3, touch enabled, Android Chrome user agent, light scheme: initial load, metrics, ARIA and screenshot. From s6 on, an assertMetrics step aborts the run unless the loaded page reports exactly 390x844 CSS px, DPR 3, a 390x844 screen, 5 touch points, a coarse pointer and canvas backing stores of CSS size x DPR. From s15 on, emulate also asks for a portrait-primary screen at angle 0 and both assertions expect it: without it, headless Chromium keeps the landscape-primary orientation of its 800x600 default screen.

steps.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Pixel 8) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
